consequence.statement: New optional flag; nothing changes for operators who do not set it.

original.statement: A new ingress-shim CLI flag `--extra-certificate-annotations` was added, listing annotation keys to copy from Ingress-like objects to the resulting Certificate; it has no operational consequence unless used.

decision.reason: [ev-dde3ce032096] lists this under Feature: a new ingress-shim option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, that takes a list of annotation keys to copy from Ingress-like objects to the resulting Certificate. If an operator does nothing, the option stays unset. The evidence does not say anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or changes when it is unset. So consequence kind "none" (informational) is supported, and P3's behavior-change only describes what happens after an operator opts in.
